_about: Copy to agent-config.json in TEMPO_AGENT_HOME (default: the tempo-agent folder for the Python harness, ~/.perennos-tempo-agent for the Rust binary). It is git-ignored: keep real paths, hosts and names there, never in the repository. Every key is optional; ~ expands to your home folder. The Python harness and the Rust tempo-agent read the same file and ignore keys they do not use.
